title: Validation of A Method to Compensate Multicenter Effects Affecting CT Radiomics

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Validation of A Method to Compensate Multicenter Effects Affecting CT Radiomics》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Purpose To investigate whether a compensation method could correct for the variations of radiomic feature values caused by using different CT protocols.

evidence.text: Purpose To investigate whether a compensation method could correct for the variations of radiomic feature values caused by using different CT protocols.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Validation of A Method to Compensate Multicenter Effects Affecting CT Radiomics》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Materials and Methods Phantom data involving 10 texture patterns and 74 patients in cohorts 1 (19 men; 42 patients; mean age, 60.4 years; September-October 2013) and 2 (16 men; 32 patients; mean age, 62.1 years; January-September 2007) scanned by using different CT protocols were retrospectively included.

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】The correction for scanner effect was confirmed in patient data with 100% (10 of 10 features for cohort 1) and 98% (87 of 89 features for cohort 2) of P values less than .05 before compensation, compared with 30% (three of 10) and 15% (13 of 89) after compensation.

evidence.text: Materials and Methods Phantom data involving 10 texture patterns and 74 patients in cohorts 1 (19 men; 42 patients; mean age, 60.4 years; September-October 2013) and 2 (16 men; 32 patients; mean age, 62.1 years; January-September 2007) scanned by using different CT protocols were retrospectively included.

The correction for scanner effect was confirmed in patient data with 100% (10 of 10 features for cohort 1) and 98% (87 of 89 features for cohort 2) of P values less than .05 before compensation, compared with 30% (three of 10) and 15% (13 of 89) after compensation.
